Company Description

Welcome to the good side of tech

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia or Docplanner. The names are different depending on the country we are located in, but we are all part of Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step helping people live longer and healthier lives?

Where does Feegow fit here?

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health-tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top-tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end-to-end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high-quality healthcare.

Docplanner Group at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300.000+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we\'re 100% remote-friendly.

Remote model: you can work 100% from home, but you are also welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

Feegow is the leading Practice Management System (PMS) in Brazil for individual doctors & large clinics alike, and a highly strategic product for Docplanner Group, as a foundation to conquer the Brazilian market.

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Director of Product for Feegow to lead our product teams, drive innovation, accountability, and play a key role in our product\'s modernization. This is a remote-friendly role within Brazil, where you’ll foster collaboration between global teams, steer product development, and manage a talented product team. Your expertise in building a data-driven & business minded product culture whilst delivering fast & safe iterations, knowing when to go for PoCs & robust solutions based on the business appetite and product maturity will ensure the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

What we expect from this position:

  • Inspire, lead and bring in PMS product vision to all product managers and teams.
  • Understand a complex environment where the teams have not only individual doctors and clinics that should be delighted with their Efficiency platform, whilst bringing them new value propositions like Visibility & Growth, as well as betting on AI as a door opener for exponential value.
  • Define with PMs the product strategy on every team, how it relates to the broader Brazilian strategy & Docplanner Tech & Product strategy.
  • Influence and establish a shared vision with other business areas as Sales, Operations and Marketing. Be a key stakeholder for Individuals and Clinics Business owners.
  • Ensure upcoming product needs and opportunities aligned with your Engineering Director and Country Managers to create a coherent Product & Tech Strategy and Roadmap.
  • Champion a hands-on approach to innovation by using a combination of Data, listening to the market, and “getting out of the building” to get first-hand customer/user insights.
  • Create a culture of decision-making based on insight, analysis and data across the business.
  • Work closely with our Global VP Product, on standardizing the objectives in clear indicators & tasks and bring transparency on ‘the plan’ across the whole company.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years’ work experience as Product Director / GPM (managing and coaching a group of Product Managers)
  • Experience on B2B SaaS scale-ups
  • Solid experience in fast high-growth environment, change management, & business growth
  • A proven track record of delivering significant success, scaling and developing high performing digital products that impact business & delight customers
  • Expertise in the end-to-end product development lifecycle, agile and lean software development practices
  • An entrepreneurial mindset with outstanding organizational, communicative and leadership skills
  • Business savvy, holistic business acumen outside of Product Management and ability to assess product market fit
  • Analytical abilities and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in healthcare is a plus not a must
  • Experience in modernizing tech debt whilst delivering product value is a plus
  • Hands-on: In Docplanner, being a people manager does not mean only managing people, but being able to dive in the details of problems, opportunities & solutions.

Let’s talk money

  • A salary adequate to your experience and skills between R$37,000and R$44.500. Your salary will be, now and always, 100% transparent to you;

Benefits:

Overview

Ruby Labs is looking for a Technical Product Owner to lead the development and rollout of the Payment Orchestration System. This role is central to aligning engineering and integration efforts with our product strategy for payments and billing in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of the Payment Orchestration System MVP by coordinating the integration and implementation of new payment service providers, aligning technical initiatives with product strategy.
  • Own and prioritize the product backlog, translating business needs and stakeholder goals into clear, actionable user stories that guide engineering and integration teams.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, Integration, Architecture, and the Head of Payments & Billing to ensure timely, high-quality delivery across the payments ecosystem.
  • Define and adapt Agile workflows (SCRUM, Kanban, or hybrid) to fit team dynamics, driving efficiency through daily stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Manage and track work progress, ensuring transparency, accountability, and accurate reporting.
  • Maintain up-to-date product documentation, technical specifications, and decision records to foster alignment and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders, providing regular updates on progress, risks, and delivery timelines.
  • Champion Agile and product management best practices to continuously improve team performance, product quality, and customer value delivery.
  • Support QA and UAT efforts to ensure reliability and compliance of payment and billing subsystems.
  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives as needed, supporting broader product and organizational goals.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or Technical Product Manager, preferably in fintech, payments, billing, or SaaS environments.
  • Strong understanding of payment ecosystems, including PSPs, payment orchestration, billing flows, and integration models.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful APIs, including ability to read API documentation, understand request/response cycles, and collaborate with engineers on interface definitions.
  • Familiarity with SDKs and developer tools; capable of supporting integration efforts and assessing third-party SDK capabilities.
  • Basic programming/scripting knowledge (e.g. JavaScript, Python, or similar) to support technical discussions, perform lightweight testing, or work with tools like Postman and Swagger.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies (SCRUM, Kanban, or hybrid models); ability to lead Agile ceremonies and continuously improve team workflows.
  • Proficiency with product and project management tools (e.g. JIRA, Confluence, Plane.so, Outline).
  • Ability to write clear and concise user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, especially Engineering, Architecture, QA, and external partners.
  • Prior experience with PCI compliance, fraud prevention, or billing automation in a product context.
  • Knowledge of testing frameworks and data analysis tools (e.g. Looker, SQL) for product insights and validation.
  • Previous involvement in system migrations, particularly payment infrastructure transitions or tool replacements.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply as long as they are located within approximately ±4 hours of CET to ensure optimal collaboration during working hours.

Benefits

  • Remote Work Environment: Work from anywhere to support work-life balance.
  • Unlimited PTO: Unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize well-being.
  • Paid National Holidays: Paid time off on national holidays.
  • Company-provided MacBook: Equipment provided as needed.
  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Autonomy and flexibility with related benefits.

Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screening (approx. 40 minutes)
  • First Interview (approx. 35 minutes)
  • Final Interview (approx. 45 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We seek ambitious, driven individuals who want to grow and make an impact.

title: Revenue Operations Sr Analyst
description:
Overview

Teachable is trusted by creator-educators around the world to grow their impact and income. From online courses and communities to memberships and downloads, Teachable's digital learning products help creator-educators drive meaningful connection and sustainable revenue. With industry-best ecommerce tools, easily toggled on directly within the platform, creators can confidently maximize their earnings, while getting paid directly by their audience. Teachable's unmatched focus on the student learning experience also ensures creators can make a positive and influential impact on their communities—entirely on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creator-educators use Teachable to share their knowledge, reaching millions of students around the world. To learn more, visit teachable.com.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the globalHotmart Company portfolio, whose platforms have helped creators earn more than $10 billion, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!

Your Mission

We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic Revenue Operations Sr Analyst to strengthen our sales strategy and accelerate our go-to-market engine in a rapidly growing SaaS company. You will partner with Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Data teams to design scalable processes, implement effective incentives and structures, and ensure execution aligns with business priorities. This is a high-impact role with strong visibility and influence across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Sales and executive leadership to define the go-to-market strategy —including segmentation, sales motions, and revenue growth priorities.
  • Design and continuously refine quota-setting frameworks, territory models, and headcount planning to enable scalable growth.
  • Develop compensation strategies and incentive structures that drive exceptional performance while aligning with company objectives.
  • Build and manage strategic dashboards and frameworks to monitor sales productivity, forecast accuracy, CAC payback, and other core SaaS KPIs; conduct deeper analysis using Excel/Google Sheets as needed.
  • Translate business questions into analytical projects , delivering actionable insights to guide product focus, market entry, and commercial efficiency.
  • Drive operational rigor through annual/quarterly planning cycles, cross-functional alignment, and performance reviews.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across tools, data flows, and CRM workflows (HubSpot) to enhance efficiency at scale.

Requirements

  • 3–4 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or Business Operations , preferably within a SaaS or technology company.
  • Strong proficiency in Excel/Sheets and CRM tools (HubSpot knowledge is a plus | SQL, Python is a plus ).
  • Solid understanding of SaaS metrics, sales cycles, and revenue motions (new business, upsell, retention).
  • Excellent communication skills in English (both written and verbal).
  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and independently lead complex initiatives.
  • Comfortable presenting insights and recommendations to senior leadership .
  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Business, Engineering, or a related field .

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work in a high-growth SaaS environment with global exposure.
  • Direct impact on go-to-market strategy and revenue growth .
  • Collaborative, data-driven, and entrepreneurial culture .
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.

This is a role based in Brazil, and you’ll collaborate closely with teams across the U.S. and Brazil. Your work will follow Brasilia Standard Time (BRT), and you’ll be hired as a CLT contract employee with compensation in BRL.

While Teachable maintains our NY office for local employees to use, we operate as a remote-first culture in order to give our employees added flexibility. In order to maintain connection and create a community beyond the screen, Teachable holds in-person events throughout the year, where employees and teams can come together for bonding, strategic alignment, goal-setting, and celebrations!

Teachable encourages individuals from a broad diversity of backgrounds to apply for positions. We are an equal opportunity employer, meaning we're committed to a fair and consistent interview process. Please tell us in your application if you require an accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job.

Application

This position is exclusively for Brazil-based engineering talent on a CLT contract paid in BRL. Relocation will not be considered at this time.

You will be required to speak English daily in written and verbal communication with our global (Brazil and U.S. team).

title: Scaled Customer Manager - On Demand
description:
Company Overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

What you\'ll do

As the Scaled Customer Manager, you are an extension of the Customer Success Account Management (CSAM) team that oversees an incoming queue of requests. Their primary function is to connect customers with the right resources, ensuring an outstanding customer experience as measured by NPS, net revenue retention, referrals, and product usage indicators. The Scaled Customer Manager performs just-in-time tactical account management activities. They will collaborate with other team members to coordinate successful customer engagement, product enablement, and demonstrate value across the entire customer journey.

This position is an individual contributor reporting to the Manager, Scaled Customer Management.

Responsibility
  • Monitor and manage a high volume of customer inquiries through digital channels
  • Triage requests by routing to the appropriate internal teams or providing self-service content; escalate patterns or systemic issues as needed
  • Create and assign CTAs (Call To Actions) to On-Demand 1:1 Specialists or other internal stakeholders
  • Respond to customers with clear, friendly, and accurate email communication that addresses immediate needs and encourages 1:1 engagement when appropriate
  • Track and document engagement outcomes in Salesforce or Gainsight
  • Maintain and contribute to a response library and create reusable content for recurring inquiries
  • Collaborate with Digital and On Demand SCMs, Support, Product, and CS teams to ensure aligned messaging and coordinated engagement
  • Support KPIs related to CSAT, retention, and resolution time through effective queue management and triage execution

description:
Overview

Hi! Weare DATA Group and we are searching for the best talent! Our goal is tosimplify our clients' lives with innovative IT solutions. We operate at globalscale and we are expanding to Portugal!

If youare passionate and have the desire to make the difference, we want to get toknow you! Join us to be part of this incredible adventure! Whoare we looking for? YOU!

Position Overview

The Senior Data Engineer is a highly skilled technical expert in Snowflake development, responsible for designing, implementing, and optimizing data solutions within Snowflake. This individual has a strong background in SQL, a solid understanding of Snowflake Architecture, and at least basic experience or training with dbt Cloud. The Senior Data Engineer will work on complex data engineering projects, deliver high-quality technical solutions, and provide mentorship and guidance to junior engineers while adhering to best practices and performance standards.

Responsibilities

  • Solution Design and Implementation: Independently design and implement technical solutions for assigned tasks, ensuring they align with coding best practices and performance standards. Utilize in-depth knowledge of Snowflake and SQL to develop scalable, efficient, and performant data pipelines and architectures. Create performant solutions following Snowflake performance best practices, ensuring optimal use of resources and minimal processing time. Leverage dbt Cloud for data transformations, ensuring robust and well-documented code.
  • Technical Expertise and Guidance: Act as a technical expert in Snowflake and dbt Cloud development, providing guidance and support to less experienced Data Engineers. Mentor junior engineers, helping them develop technical skills, understand best practices, and gain familiarity with the company's infrastructure and data pipeline. Answer technical questions and help solve problems faced by junior team members, ensuring consistency and quality in solutions.
  • Collaboration and Stakeholder Engagement: Participate in technical discussions, providing input on tickets, bugs, and proposed solutions. Raise concerns and identify obstacles proactively, offering potential solutions to overcome them. Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer on technical implementations and escalated issues. Clarify requirements and business-related questions with the Solution/Product Owner, ensuring alignment between technical solutions and business objectives.
  • Continuous Improvement and Best Practices: Follow and contribute to the development of internal coding best practices for data engineering solutions. Stay up-to-date with new Snowflake features, technologies, and industry trends, incorporating them into project work as appropriate. Continuously look for opportunities to improve existing processes, workflows, and performance across the data pipeline.

Required Knowledge and Skills

  • In-depth knowledge of Snowflake, SQL, and Git.
  • Basic experience with dbt Cloud or confirmed training in data transformations.
  • Solid understanding of Snowflake Architecture, including how to design and optimize data models.
  • Familiarity with agile implementation methods and project management tools such as Azure DevOps and Jira.
  • Ability to design efficient, scalable data pipelines and ensure the overall performance of the Snowflake environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on delivering high-quality solutions.

Expectations

  • The Senior Data Engineer is expected to meet the same core expectations as a Data Engineer, with added autonomy and responsibility for complex technical solutions.
  • Ability to resolve assigned tasks independently and deliver solutions within project timelines.
  • Proactively mentor and support less experienced Data Engineers, ensuring the team follows best practices.
  • Engage actively in technical discussions, sharing knowledge and insights to drive continuous improvement.

Preferred Experience

  • 6+ years of experience in data engineering, with a focus on Snowflake and cloud-based data technologies.
  • Practical experience with dbt Cloud or equivalent data transformation tools.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies and experience working in an agile development environment.
  • Prior experience working in a collaborative, cross-functional team setting.

This position provides an exciting opportunity to work on advanced data engineering projects, contribute to the success of complex data initiatives, and grow your career while mentoring others. If you are passionate about Snowflake and enjoy working with cutting-edge technologies, we encourage you to apply.

title: Freight Coordinator
description:
Commitment: Full-time (Approx. 40 hours/week)

Company Overview:

Tidal is a Direct Placement Agency that helps job seekers find job opportunities for real growth. We work with stable, responsible businesses experienced in remote hires and are excited to welcome international team members. Tidal is owned and operated by consumer brand owners and operators. We have offshore team-building experience and aim to help businesses leverage global talent.

About This Role:

We are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Freight Coordinator to join the Logistics team of one of our valued clients. The right candidate will thrive in a remote setting and be responsible for managing the end-to-end freight scheduling and delivery process. This includes coordinating pickups and deliveries, handling exception management, overseeing return shipments, and ensuring data accuracy. The ideal candidate will be proactive, possess strong communication skills, and have a deep understanding of logistics and freight operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Communicate with carriers, freight forwarders, 3PL warehouses, and retail partners to coordinate pickup and delivery schedules.
  • Schedule and confirm inventory pick-ups from 3PL warehouses based on shipping plans.
  • Coordinate delivery appointments with retail partners and carriers to ensure timely arrivals.
  • Manage shipping documentation, including BOLs, labels, packing slips, and invoices.
  • Track shipments in transit and provide timely updates to stakeholders.
  • Monitor delivery status and resolve issues like delays, missed pick-ups, and damage claims.
  • Handle reverse logistics and manage return shipments from stores to 3PL warehouses.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and tracking of returned inventory.
  • Maintain shipment logs, track KPIs, and prepare regular performance reports.
  • Act as the main point of contact for freight scheduling and updates with internal and external teams.

Software/Platforms/Tools:

  • ERP Software (e.g., Netsuite)
  • TMS (Transportation Management Systems)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management Systems)
  • Shipment tracking tools
  • Excel
  • Google Sheets
  • Google Suite
  • Slack
  • Zoom
  • Monday.com

Qualifications:

  • At least 3-5 years of freelancing experience
  • 2+ years of experience in freight coordination, logistics, or supply chain support, ideally with retail and/or 3PL exposure.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple shipments and exceptions simultaneously.
  • Experience working with ERP (e.g., Netsuite), TMS (Transportation Management Systems), WMS (Warehouse Management Systems), or shipment tracking tools.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Proficiency with Excel and Google Sheets for shipment tracking and reporting.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote/offshore environment and manage time zones effectively.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience working with U.S.-based logistics operations.
  • Familiarity with retail distribution and reverse logistics processes.

The Hanover has been committed to delivering on our promises and being there when it matters the most for more than 170 years. We live our values every day, demonstrating we CARE through our values, Sustainability initiatives and inclusive corporate culture.

Hanover is seeking a dynamic and strategic business development professional to join our Specialty Distribution Management Team. This role will support both the Professional and Executive Lines Segment as well as the Property & Casualty and Marine lines within Hanover’s Specialty Division.

As a Regional Distribution Director – Specialty Insurance, you will be responsible for driving growth across a broad portfolio that includes Specialty Property & Casualty, Marine, Professional Liability, Management and Executive Liability, Healthcare, and Cyber insurance. You will report directly to the Regional Distribution Director and work closely with the Specialty Business Units and Hanover Field teams to align on strategy and execution.

We are looking for a high-energy, collaborative, and sales-minded individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is passionate about building strong relationships and delivering results. This is a hybrid role based in Washington or Oregon supporting the Pacific Northwest Region.

We are proud to be a diverse and inclusive organization that values the unique perspectives and experiences of all individuals. We encourage all qualified professionals to apply and join us in building a stronger, more innovative community.

This is a full-time, exempt role.

We encourage all qualified professionals to apply

Position Overview

The Regional Distribution Director is the business development leader of our Specialty Insurance segments for Pacific Northwest Region (Washington, Oregon, and Idaho). Our Specialty Insurance business lines include Professional Liability, Management Liability, Cyber, Health Care, Specialty P&C, and Marine. The incumbent is responsible for collaborative development, implementation, and execution of Specialty’s strategic direction, production goals and operational objectives for all distribution sources and field network partners.

The Regional Distribution Director will lead, manage, and direct the distribution of Specialty business in the Pacific Northwest. They will be responsible for marketing all Specialty lines and to promote profitable new sales growth. They will drive the development of business opportunities and partnerships within the Specialty business segments, field teams, and with our Agent and Wholesale partners.

In This Role, You Will :

  • Identifies new business development opportunities, deepening relevancy with Target Agents/Wholesalers, and expanding distribution through Specialty focused agents to achieve target specialty returns.
  • Collaborates closely with Regional Vice Presidents to own and develop the distribution strategies for assigned region.
  • Segments existing agents and field territories, and allocated resources accordingly, with specific focus on target agent/wholesale partners.
  • Establishes agent and local office development plans, monitors results and takes appropriate action as needed to advance Specialty growth.
  • Develops production goals for target Agents/Wholesalers within their region. Is responsible for monitoring the progress and results of these target Agents/Wholesalers within the region.
  • For target Agents/Wholesalers within their region will organizes sales meetings, sales contests, and incentive programs to stimulate growth.
  • Assembles competitive data and local market intelligence to provide feedback to Specialty business unit leaders, new business underwriters, and loss control partners to address product and pricing needs.
  • Analyzes management reports and takes appropriate action to assure ongoing production momentum and profitability.
  • Designs and implements regional and branch specific marketing strategies and operational plans including participation in general business pricing strategy decisions.
  • Works in conjunction with local office leadership to develop and manage a stable of target agents in each territory ensuring that the relationship and yield from each target agent remains productive.
  • Regularly interfaces with Small Commercial Sales Managers, Regional Vice Presidents, and other business unit leaders in territory to cross-sell business. Always maintaining regular contact with all target agent partners and field leadership to offer a Total Hanover insurance solution when available.

Key Measures of Success

  • Achievement of Regional business objectives:
    • Achieve top line specialty new business goals
    • Visibility through meaningful sales calls
    • Identify specialty consolidation opportunities
    • Large account pipelining
    • Drive increased utilization of our small Specialty products that can be quoted online through TAP Sales
    • Prospect new relationships that have outsized Specialty opportunities
  • Time with Target Agents – identify and manage key target agents within the region with a goal to help drive significant sustainable growth from the key agents within the region.
  • Monitor service and quality metrics to promote the timely turnaround of Specialty quotes within the region.

What You Need To Apply

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Higher. Industry Designations (CIC,CRM, RPLU, CPCU) Preferred
  • 5 - 10 years Commercial Lines Business Development/Sales Management experience required, Professional Lines or Property & Casualty experience preferred
  • Proven track record of achieving sales goals/objectives and development of territorial business plans and supporting initiatives
  • Proven ability to effectively manage and balance multiple sales priorities in a dynamic and very fast-paced environment
  • Strong collaboration and influence skills, particularly with field leadership, agency decision makers and key stakeholders
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills are essential including interpersonal interactions, presentations, and written communications, including impeccable follow through
  • Consistently demonstrates exceptional business acumen and functional knowledge of product offerings, technologies, distribution channels and service strategies, as appropriate
  • Project/Program Management – understands the principles, theories, practices, and techniques involved in planning, managing, and implementing projects and programs
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office and Sales Force
  • Ability to travel frequently (~50% overall; mix of day/overnight travel will vary by week)

CAREER DEVELOPMENT

It’s not just a job, it’s a career, and we are here to support you every step of the way. We want you to be successful and fulfilled. Through on-the-job experiences, personalized coaching and our robust learning and development programs, we encourage you – at every level – to grow and develop.

BENEFITS

We offer comprehensive benefits to help you be healthy, build financial security, and balance work and home life. At The Hanover, you’ll enjoy what you do and have the support you need to succeed.

At Boulevard, our Customer Experience team is dedicated to launching, supporting, and strengthening relationships with our clients. As an Onboarding Specialist , Data Migrations , you will play a pivotal role in helping customers transition from legacy systems to the Boulevard platform with minimal disruption and maximum confidence.

You'll be the technical partner behind the scenes—transforming, cleaning, and validating data to ensure accuracy, security, and a seamless migration experience. From pre-sale planning through post-launch cleanup, you'll own end-to-end data migration workflows while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure every customer launch is a success.

What you'll do here:

Pre-Sale & Scoping

  • Meet with prospective clients pre-close to understand their data needs and align migration expectations.
  • Partner with Sales to scope technical requirements and validate feasibility.
  • Participate in customer and prospect calls as a subject matter expert on data migrations.

Data Migration & Import

  • Own and manage full-service and free import migrations from initial planning through final execution.
  • Perform imports using tools such as Flatfile and Google Sheets with high accuracy and consistency.
  • Execute structured QA and validation checks on all data prior to launch.
  • Handle migration-related CFDs/CSRs and execute bulk updates (e.g., pricing changes, contact edits).
  • Clean up migrations on launch day in partnership with Onboarding Specialists, focusing on data integrity.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Coordinate full-service migrations with teams like Odetta and Customer Operations (COPS).
  • Work closely with Engineering to manage escalations, track bugs, and improve tooling.
  • Partner with COPS and Engineering on Flatfile improvements and onboarding tools.
  • Support Onboarding Specialists in resolving real-time data issues during customer launches.

Operational & Team Support

  • Track migration timelines, coordinate launch calendars, and communicate progress and blockers clearly.
  • Answer internal team questions in shared Slack channels (#onboarding-questions, etc.).
  • Assist in data review for proof-of-concept migrations for strategic accounts.
  • Create and maintain internal documentation and one-sheets related to migrations and tooling.

What you'll need to thrive:

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience managing data migrations or working with platform dashboards.
  • 1+ year of direct experience with Boulevard dashboard and data migrations (preferred).
  • Advanced skills in Google Sheets or Excel -comfortable with formulas, lookups, pivot tables, and structured data manipulation.
  • Strong troubleshooting and technical problem-solving abilities under pressure.
  • Excellent project and time management—able to juggle multiple migrations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
  • Highly detail-oriented with a strong commitment to data accuracy and security.
  • Clear, confident communicator with the ability to collaborate across departments and work independently.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with Flatfile or similar structured import tools.
  • Experience with SaaS onboarding, technical support, or customer implementation.
  • Knowledge of data privacy best practices, especially around marketing consent and HIPAA customer data handling.

How we'll take care of you:

Job Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Sales Analyst to join our dynamic Sales & E-Commerce team. This role is critical in driving data-informed decisions by tracking and analyzing monthly sales performance, market share trends, and Cricut’s position across key retailers and online platforms, including growth opportunities in Latin America.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and report monthly sales in and out across retail and e-commerce channels.

  • Develop dashboards and visualizations to communicate trends and insights.
  • Market Share Analysis
  • Analyze Cricut’s market share across key retailers and platforms.
  • Benchmark performance against competitors using syndicated data sources.
  • Identify growth opportunities and areas of concern based on market dynamics.
  • Track performance metrics for top retail partners and e-commerce platforms.
  • Collaborate with account managers to provide actionable insights for sales strategies.
  • Support promotional planning and post-event analysis with data-driven evaluations.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Partner with Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams to align on forecasts and performance metrics.
  • Assist in preparing executive-level presentations and business reviews.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in sales analysis, business intelligence, or retail analytics.
  • Proficiency in Excel, Power BI/Tableau, and data visualization tools.
  • Experience with syndicated data (e.g., NPD, Circana, Nielsen) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical mindset with attention to detail and storytelling ability.

Additional Information

**This person will be based in Latin America, specifically in Brazil, Mexico, or Argentina**

Cricut is in a powerful chapter of transformation. We’re evolving fast—refining our strategy, growing our teams, and raising the bar across the board. This is an incredible opportunity for the right kind of person—but it’s not for everyone.

We’re looking forA-players —people who don’t just meet expectations, but consistently exceed them. If you thrive in dynamic environments and find joy in turning challenges into momentum, keep reading.

Here’s what makes someone a great fit for this role (and for this moment at Cricut):

You have a bias for urgency.

You don’t wait for perfect clarity to take action—you start, learn, and adjust. You believe that speed matters, especially when paired with thoughtfulness. You ask: “What can move forward today?” and push past inertia.

You set high standards—especially for yourself.

You’re proud of your work and protective of your reputation. You take ownership, deliver quality, and don’t cut corners. You hold yourself accountable without waiting to be asked.

You stay focused when things are moving fast.

You can identify what really matters and don’t get distracted by noise. You prioritize well and manage your time wisely.

You elevate the people around you, communicate clearly, and give thoughtful feedback. You’re low ego, high output—and your team loves working with you.

What to Do Next:

Please attach your resume, cover letter and/or include links to your portfolio or other social presence. If you want to show your super powers in other ways – include that information too. Role

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Manager of Instructional Teams, reporting to the Director of Student Experience and Success, is responsible for overseeing the learner experience while supporting the instructional staff in delivering high-quality instruction. The role supports student progress and drives retention by monitoring cohort health metrics, managing transfers and dismissals, and ensuring compliance with company policies and regulations. The Manager of Instructional Teams provides ongoing coaching and evaluation for instructors, supervises Learner Experience Managers and the Manager of Curriculum, and partners with HR and recruiting on faculty hiring, onboarding, and staffing. By managing instructional resources, maintaining SOPs, and supporting curriculum updates, the Manager of Instructional Teams ensures academic operations run efficiently and consistently. This leadership role plays a critical part in strengthening teaching effectiveness, supporting instructional staff, and enhancing the overall student experience.

This role is full-time and remote. Please note: the ability to flex hours is critical in supporting instructional team members and will be an expectation of the person in this role.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure an exceptional student experience by supporting student progress, accessibility, and overall success
  • Oversee student experience by monitoring progress and retention, implementing strategies for improvement
  • Manage student transfers, withdrawals, and dismissals in accordance with company policies
  • Serve as a point of escalation for student concerns and resolutions
  • Develop student accommodation plans, ensuring alignment of practices with ADA requirements

  • Liaise between Finance and Learner Experience teams to improve retention outcomes
  • Collaborate with the curriculum team to update courses with new iterations based on learner and staff feedback
  • Supervise the Manager of Curriculum, aligning tasks with student needs

  • 2+ years of experience in education, teaching, instructional coaching, academic operations, or learning and development, specifically supporting instructors or trainers to drive learner success, managing projects, and hiring new team members
  • Bachelor's degree required. Master's Degree preferred
  • Experience with onboarding and building effective teams

About Ethos

Ethos was built to make it faster and easier to get life insurance for the next million families. Our approach blends industry expertise, technology, and the human touch to find you the right policy to protect your loved ones.

We leverage deep technology and data science to streamline the life insurance process, making it more accessible and convenient. Using predictive analytics, we are able to transform a traditionally multi-week process into a modern digital experience for our users that can take just minutes! We’ve issued billions in coverage each month and eliminated the traditional barriers, ushering the industry into the modern age. Our full-stack technology platform is the backbone of family financial health.

We make getting life insurance easier, faster and better for everyone.

Our investors include General Catalyst, Sequoia Capital, Accel Partners, Google Ventures, SoftBank, and the investment vehicles of Jay-Z, Kevin Durant, Robert Downey Jr and others. This year, we were named on CB Insights' Global Insurtech 50 list and BuiltIn's Top 100 Midsize Companies in San Francisco. We are scaling quickly and looking for passionate people to protect the next million families!

About the Role

Ethos is seeking a dynamic expert to take ownership of our regulatory product and forms filing. In this role, you’ll blend hands-on regulatory acumen with forward-looking product innovation to bring life insurance solutions to the market efficiently and compliantly. You’ll collaborate with carriers and cross-functional teams to navigate complex state regulations, ensuring new products and policy forms are designed, filed, and approved seamlessly. Your industry relationships and deep subject-matter expertise will be essential to influence regulators, shape product designs, and accelerate approvals.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead Filing: Own and manage the Ethos portion of the filing process for policy forms and applications, ensuring speed, compliance, and quality.
  • Inform Product Development Strategy: Collaborate with Product, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, and carrier partners to refine product features and applications that balance innovation with regulatory standards.
  • Optimize Application Design: Provide expert guidance on bracketing, reflexive questions, and variability, enabling flexible yet compliant product offerings.
  • Monitor Industry Trends: Stay ahead of regulatory changes and competitor filings, translating insights into tangible strategies and recommendations for product evolution.
  • Improve Processes Continuously: Innovate on filing processes by implementing best practices and technology solutions, bolstering efficiency and accuracy.

Qualifications and Skills

  • 5+ years in product form filings with strong understanding of state insurance department standards and requirements.
  • Broad knowledge of insurance products and regulatory frameworks.
  • Ability to read and interpret laws and regulations related to product and endorsement forms and filings.
  • Proven ability to shape and refine insurance applications, other new business and disclosure forms, and related statements of variability based on internal, Carrier, and Regulator feedback.
  • Strong collaborative communication skills.
  • Ability to work cross-functionally with carriers, legal, and compliance, UW, product development and product teams.
  • Highly self-sufficient and entrepreneurial, capable of driving both strategic initiatives, day-to-day filings, and forms creation and maintenance.
  • Experience in SERFF system a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; JD, CPCU, FLMI, or AIRC a plus.
  • Ownership: Take the reins of product regulatory filings and guide the creation of innovative solutions.
  • Industry Influence: Build on your regulator relationships and shape the market through strategic advocacy.
  • Impactful Collaboration: Partner with a wide range of teams to harmonize regulatory needs with product vision.
  • High-Growth Environment: Join a rapidly evolving organization where your expertise can drive both immediate and long-term success.

If you’re ready to lead the charge in filing next-generation life insurance products—from concept to approval—we’d love to connect!

This role sits at the core of our growth engine, requiring a deep understanding of campaign management, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration to drive subscriptions and improve conversion rates across the funnel.   • Cross-functional collaborator: You have the ability to work effectively with product, web, creative, and analytics teams to optimize acquisition performance from end to end.

  • Experience with international markets outside of the US or managing global accounts.
  • Experience within startup or scale-up environments.
  • Experience working with ed-tech or subscription based companies.

title: Fund Administrator
description:
Our client is a growing fund services provider with a strong focus on crypto and digital assets. With plans to expand into corporate services, regulatory support, and investor transactions, they are building a forward-looking team to support this growth.

We are seeking a Fund Administrator to support the current Manager of Fund Administration and play a key role in day-to-day fund operations. This mid-level role is designed for someone who wants to grow into management over time as the business evolves.

This role is ideal for a detail-oriented professional with solid fund administration experience and a strong interest in digital assets. The right candidate will be proactive, adaptable, and motivated to build a career in a fast-changing sector.

Full-Time
Schedule: Bahamas time zone
Location: Fully remote (fluent English and Portuguese required, Brazil-based candidates preferred)
Engagement: Independent Contractor
Start Date: ASAP
Monthly Rate: $ (depending on level of experience)

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage investor onboarding and compliance, including KYC/AML checks.

  • Maintain accurate investor registry records (investors, unit/share classes, transactions).

  • Process subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, capital calls, and distributions.

  • Prepare and send investor statements, handle queries, and liaise with custodians.

  • Prepare and review investor reports, financial statements, and regulatory filings.

  • Handle transactions and reporting related to crypto assets (valuation, custody, liquidity).

  • Ensure compliance with AML/KYC, FATCA/CRS, and relevant digital asset regulations.

  • Support the Fund Administration Manager in building processes and internal controls.

  • Liaise with auditors, custodians, and regulators as required.

  • Stay up-to-date with digital asset fund regulations and apply them in operations.

Requirements

  • Approximately 5 years of experience in fund administration, ideally with exposure to digital asset/crypto funds.

  • Strong knowledge of fund operations: NAV calculation, reconciliation, investor reporting, compliance.

  • Hands-on experience with investor services (onboarding, AML/KYC, registry, subscriptions/redemptions, capital calls).

  • Familiarity with crypto-specific operations (custody, valuation, liquidity, transaction handling).

  • Understanding of compliance and regulatory frameworks (AML/KYC, FATCA/CRS).

  • Proficiency in Excel and fund administration software (e.g., Advent, Investran, PFS-PAXUS).

  • High attention to detail and accuracy with financial data.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluent in English; Portuguese required for Brazil-based applicants.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Relevant certifications (CAIA, CFA, CPA modules, blockchain/crypto finance certifications).

  • Experience with corporate services, regulatory reporting, or investor transactions.

  • Previous exposure to start-up or fast-growing fund administration environments.

  • Growth mindset — staying updated on trends/regulations in digital assets.

  1. Initial Interview

  2. Client Interview(s)

  3. Offer & Onboarding
